notes: Windows' own Start menu and search no longer open while the RapTech Start panel is installed: the Windows Start and Search items are gone from the panel, Win+S and Win+Q open the RapTech panel, and the taskbar's search box is hidden (Uninstall puts it back as it was). Staff pin apps with right-click > Pin to Start in File Explorer. The Start button wears Windows' own logo by default, and the Start menu tab lets you pick Windows 11, Windows 10, a classic orb or the RapTech logo. The Start panel's program is now Start.exe and shows in Task Manager as plain "Start" with no RapTech icon. Goes with counter 1.50.0.
